title: Fix the macOS root-probe watcher calibration timeout that fails the parity suite before any assertion runs
outcome: Fix the macOS root-probe watcher calibration timeout that fails the parity suite before any assertion runs
acceptance: On macOS (Mac runner, darwin arm64), the parity test "host commands resolve identity without a probe marker; agent and MCP emit none" passes in a full gate, with its RootJournal fs.watch calibration barrier observed

The root cause of the missing calibration event (watcher startup or delivery on Darwin) is identified and fixed in scripts/root-probe-harness.mjs or its caller, without raising the timeout, skipping the test, or retrying until green
The parity suite passes in full gates on both macOS and Windows after the fix
